fields.name: collaboration_hours_threshold_initial
fields.description: Number of post-graduate clinical practice hours during which a PA must engage in active collaboration with a physician before being permitted to practice more independently.
fields.sample_quote: engage in collaboration with a physician for the first 4,000 hours of the physician assistant's post-graduate clinical practice experience

fields.name: collaboration_hours_threshold_independent
fields.description: Total post-graduate clinical practice hours after which a PA may practice without a formal written collaborative agreement.
fields.sample_quote: A physician assistant with less than 10,000 hours of post-graduate clinical practice experience shall: (a) practice under written policies and procedures established at a practice level

fields.name: written_collaborative_agreement_required
fields.description: Whether a PA is required to maintain a written collaborative agreement with a physician or senior PA during a defined phase of practice experience.
fields.sample_quote: a physician assistant who has more than 4,000 hours of practice experience and less than 10,000 hours of practice experience shall enter into a written collaborative agreement

fields.name: new_specialty_collaboration_hours_required
fields.description: Minimum hours of supervised collaboration required when a PA changes to a new specialty in which they have insufficient experience.
fields.sample_quote: A physician assistant who wishes to change specialties to another specialty in which the PA has less than 4,000 hours of experience shall engage in collaboration for a minimum of 4,000 hours with a physician who is trained and experienced in the specialty

fields.name: temporary_license_available
fields.category: extra credentials and tiered license types
fields.description: Whether the state offers a temporary license to PA applicants who have completed their program but have not yet passed the required examination.
fields.sample_quote: An applicant for licensure as a physician assistant who has met all qualifications for licensure except passing an examination component...may apply for and be granted a temporary license

fields.name: temporary_license_max_days
fields.category: extra credentials and tiered license types
fields.description: Maximum duration in days for which a temporary pre-examination license may be held.
fields.sample_quote: The temporary license shall be issued for a period not to exceed 120 days to allow the applicant to pass the Physician Assistant National Certifying Examination.

fields.name: mental_health_specialty_credential_available
fields.category: extra credentials and tiered license types
fields.description: Whether the state recognizes a distinct specialty credential or qualification pathway for PAs who wish to practice mental health therapy.
fields.sample_quote: A physician assistant specializing in mental health care under this section shall...obtain and maintain a Certification of Added Qualification in psychiatry issued by the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants

fields.name: mental_health_specialty_clinical_hours_required
fields.category: extra credentials and tiered license types
fields.description: Total clinical practice hours in mental health required for a PA to qualify for the mental health specialty credential.
fields.sample_quote: A physician assistant specializing in mental health care under this section shall complete 10,000 hours of clinical practice in mental health.

fields.name: general_anesthesia_prohibited
fields.category: procedures that are restricted or require extra steps
fields.description: Whether PAs are generally prohibited from administering general anesthetics, subject to defined exceptions.
fields.sample_quote: Except as provided in Subsections (c) through (e), a physician assistant may not administer general anesthetics.

fields.name: minimal_sedation_authorized
fields.category: procedures that are restricted or require extra steps
fields.description: Whether PAs are explicitly authorized to perform minimal sedation or anxiolysis within their scope of practice.
fields.sample_quote: A physician assistant may perform minimal sedation anxiolysis if the procedure is within the physician assistant's scope of practice.

fields.name: rapid_sequence_intubation_authorized_with_conditions
fields.category: procedures that are restricted or require extra steps
fields.description: Whether PAs may perform rapid sequence induction for intubation subject to specific credentialing and availability conditions.
fields.sample_quote: A physician assistant may perform rapid sequence induction for intubation of a patient if...the physician assistant holds a valid ALS/ACLS certification and is credentialed and privileged at the hospital where the procedure is performed

fields.name: neurostimulation_neuromodulation_restricted
fields.category: procedures that are restricted or require extra steps
fields.description: Whether PAs are prohibited from administering neurostimulation or neuromodulation except under physician supervision in a health care facility.
fields.sample_quote: A physician assistant may not administer neurostimulation or neuromodulation...Subsection (4)(a) does not apply to neurostimulation or neuromodulation administered by a physician assistant: (i) in a health care facility; and (ii) under supervision of a physician

fields.name: document_authentication_authority
fields.category: what they are allowed to sign and certify
fields.description: Whether PAs are explicitly authorized to authenticate documents (sign, certify, stamp, verify, etc.) to the same extent as a physician, within their scope of practice.
fields.sample_quote: A physician assistant may authenticate through a signature, certification, stamp, verification, affidavit, or endorsement any document that may be authenticated by a physician and that is within the physician assistant's scope of practice.

fields.name: title_and_identification_requirements
fields.category: how they must identify themselves to patients
fields.description: Specific statutory requirements governing how a PA must identify themselves to patients and the public, including badge and title rules.
fields.sample_quote: A physician assistant, while practicing as a physician assistant: (a) shall wear an identification badge showing the physician assistant's license classification as a physician assistant; (b) shall identify themselves to a patient as a physician assistant; and (c) may not identify themselves to any person...other than as a physician assistant or PA.

fields.name: volunteer_practice_controlled_substance_restriction
fields.description: Whether PAs providing uncompensated volunteer health services are prohibited from prescribing controlled substances to patients.
fields.sample_quote: a physician assistant who is providing volunteer health services under this section may not issue a prescription to a patient for a controlled substance.

fields.name: interstate_compact_participation
fields.description: Whether the state participates in the PA Licensure Compact, allowing qualifying licensees to practice in other member states via a compact privilege.
fields.sample_quote: "Compact Privilege" means the authorization granted by a Remote State to allow a Licensee from another Participating State to practice as a PA to provide Medical Services

fields.name: compact_privilege_nccpa_certification_required
fields.description: Whether holding current NCCPA certification is a prerequisite for exercising a compact privilege to practice in another participating state.
fields.sample_quote: To exercise the Compact Privilege, a Licensee must:...Hold current NCCPA certification.

fields.name: suicide_prevention_training_required_for_renewal
fields.category: mandatory training topics for license renewal
fields.description: Whether completion of a suicide prevention training or video is explicitly required as part of each license renewal cycle.
fields.sample_quote: Prior to license renewal, each licensee shall, during each two-year licensure cycle...view a suicide prevention video described in Section 58-1-601 and submit proof in the form required by the division

fields.name: criminal_background_check_required
fields.description: Whether applicants for licensure must submit to a fingerprint-based criminal background check through state and federal databases.
fields.sample_quote: An applicant for licensure under this chapter who requires a criminal background check shall: (a) submit fingerprint cards in a form acceptable to the division at the time the license application is filed; and (b) consent to a fingerprint background check conducted by the Bureau of Criminal Identification and the Federal Bureau of Investigation
